verdict.rationale: The evidence shows n8n's own event-trigger mechanisms: a first-party Webhook node, a community report of webhook-initiated tasks in production, a Kafka trigger node, and an MCP Server Trigger, alongside 1500+ integrations. It does not show app-specific triggers for the story's examples (new CRM record, new chat message, new email, form submission). Missing for 10: documented app-specific event triggers (e.g. new email, new record, form submission), trigger docs with depth beyond page titles, and independent hands-on corroboration of connected-app event triggers.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)

citations.quote: the kafka trigger node has zero info on its doc page
